description:
buildDayExercises runs one lastSetFor query per program exercise, and adhocExercises runs another per ad-hoc one. A ten-exercise day is eleven round-trips to build one screen, on a scale-to-zero backend where the first one already pays a cold start.

Replace with a single windowed query over the exercise ids. The exclusion of the current session (excludeSessionId) has to survive the rewrite, or "last time" starts comparing against sets logged minutes ago.
title: Batch the per-exercise last-set queries
